title: 21 · dance · The Dance
lines: Look under Nataraja's foot. Someone is there.
He has been there since the beginning. And Shiva will never kill him.
He is forgetting. Carelessness. The fog in your head.
When he runs free, people forget who they are.
The gods asked Shiva to destroy him.
Without forgetting, there is no learning.
Without the dark, no one would look for the light.
He put one foot on him.
The drum in one hand makes the world.
The fire in the other ends it.
One hand says: do not be afraid.
Two sages waited lifetimes to see it.
One with a serpent's body. One with a tiger's feet.
You do not kill your ignorance. You stand on it, every day, and dance. That is sadhana.
